question: Three scenarios did worse on this branch than on main in the first runs: git-safety and strongest-tier (2 of 3 failed here, 0 of 2 there) and the new coarse-plan-rejected (1 of 3 failed). Is that this branch's doing or chance? Six more runs of each on this branch, after two small fixes to the pyramid skill, and six more of git-safety and strongest-tier on main's kit.
machine: cloud-linux: Claude Code cloud container, Linux 6.18, Node 22.23.5, Claude Code 2.1.330, signed in with the owner's own login (no API key)
command: six times each:  node evals/run.mjs --model claude-haiku-5-5 --scenario git-safety,strongest-tier,coarse-plan-rejected --results-dir <this folder>/raw-branch   and, in a checkout of main at 06b0b92 with cli/kit bundled,  node evals/run.mjs --model claude-haiku-5-5 --scenario git-safety,strongest-tier --results-dir <this folder>/raw-main

metrics.name: checks_passed
metrics.how: the scenario's checks that passed in this arm

metrics.name: scenario_pass
metrics.how: on the 'with' case only: 1 when the harness's verdict for the scenario is pass, 0 for fail or no-difference

metrics.name: cost_usd
metrics.how: Claude Code's own estimate for the run, not a bill

notes: Written after seeing the first runs, so the choice of scenarios is not blind. The count of six was fixed here, before any of these runs.

The branch's kit in this run is the commit that adds this manifest. It differs from the kit in 2026-11-23-evals by two changes to the pyramid skill: 'Ask first' is now said in the skill's first paragraph, and a 'Checking a plan' section tells the reader to run the checker before judging a plan.
Same harness defaults: 12 turns, 240 seconds and 0.50 USD per run.

versions.kit-branch: the commit that adds this manifest
